title: Product Manager - LAP
description:
**Product Manager: LAP (MSME & Salaried)**
==========================================

**Location:** Bangalore

**Focusing:** Tier 3 & 4 towns of Karnataka, Tamil Nadu & Andhra Pradesh

**Role Overview**
-----------------

This role requires understanding of Micro & Small Enterprises in Teir 2/3 geographies, knowledge of their cash flow nuances, ability to design and scale innovative credit products tailored to that segments.

The ideal candidate will bridge on-ground insights (including competitive benchmarking) with product, credit, and technology to drive growth, improve customer experience, and unlock new revenue streams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Product Strategy & Development**

* Design customer-centric loan products based on local market needs and income patterns.
* Continuously innovate on product constructs (Technology, TAT, Tenure, Ticket size, Repayment models, Hybrid income assessment, Type of Security etc.).

### **2. Customer & Market Understanding**

* Spend significant time in the field to understand customer behavior, needs, and pain points.
* Build strong insights into MSME cash flows, salaried informal segments, and local business ecosystems.
* Translate ground-level insights into scalable product features and policies.

### **3. Financial Needs Analysis**

* Analyze customer financial requirements across lifecycle stages (working capital, expansion, personal needs).
* Develop frameworks for income assessment in low-documentation/alternate sources environments.
* Work closely with credit teams to refine underwriting models for these segments.

### **4. Cross-Sell & Revenue Enhancement**

* Identify and drive cross-sell opportunities (PL, Mobile, Vehicle Gold, Cards etc.).
* Design bundled offerings tailored to customer segments.
* Improve customer lifetime value (LTV) through product innovation.

### **5. Process Optimization (Lead to Disbursement)**

* Own end-to-end funnel: lead generation login approval disbursement.
* Identify bottlenecks and improve TAT, conversion rates, and customer experience.
* Collaborate with sales, credit, operations, and collections teams.

### **6. Tech & AI Enablement**

* Partner with tech teams to digitize and streamline processes.
* Leverage AI/ML for:
  + Lead scoring
  + Credit underwriting
  + Fraud detection
  + Customer segmentation
* Drive adoption of digital tools in field operations.

### **7. Stakeholder Management**

* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Credit, Risk, Ops, Tech, and Analytics.
* Align internal teams to deliver product outcomes.

**Key Requirements**
--------------------

### **Experience**

* 3–8 years of experience in NBFC/Banking/Fintech.
* Significant exposure to LAP, MSME lending, or retail secured lending.
* Experience working in Tier 2/3/4 markets preferred.

### **Skills & Competencies**

* **Field Orientation:** Willingness to travel extensively and engage directly with customers.
* **Comfort with Ambiguity:** Ability to operate in evolving, unstructured environments.
* **Customer Insight:** Deep understanding of MSME and salaried segments in semi-urban/rural markets.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Ability to interpret financials, cash flows, and informal income patterns.
* **Product Mindset:** Strong problem-solving and innovation capabilities.
* **Tech Awareness:** Understanding of digital lending, AI/ML applications in financial services.
* **Execution Focus:** Ability to drive outcomes across multiple stakeholders.
* **Local Language:** Knowing any one or more of Tamil, Kannada and Telugu language is preferred.

### **Education**

* MBA/PGDM (preferred) or equivalent experience in financial services.

Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.

We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.

Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.

We are seeking a Product Manager, who will be working with our clients in the high frequency trading space. One who has the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; .

### **Responsibilities**

* Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; should be comfortable facilitating discussions and working on cross-functional teams.
* Process Design: Lead sessions to understand current state processes and pain points; leverage this analysis and understand key requirements to help shape the future state process design and gain alignment across HCM and business stakeholders.
* Analytical Skills and Data Acumen: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making. They should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and other reporting tools to analyze data.
* Requirements gathering and documentation acumen: Ability to gather, document and clearly articulate product requirements (i.e., user stories, data migration requirements, etc.).
* Technical Aptitude: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles and be comfortable working with technical teams.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Work with functional and technical teams to shape the end-to-end testing strategy, spanning functional test and UAT; help test solution rigorously (along with HCM and business stakeholders) to surface and resolve critical defects ahead of a program’s launch
* Project & Change Management: Help project manage key deliverables, while helping execute against an innovative communication and training strategy – from drafting stakeholder messaging to creating high-quality learning collateral
* Understanding of Total Rewards Concepts (optional – specific to Rewards pillar): A foundational understanding of total rewards principles, including compensation structures, benefits packages (health, retirement, etc.), and other employee benefits is ideal.
* Oracle Core experience (optional): Foundational knowledge and understanding of Oracle HRIS including data management, system optimization and functionality

**Why Lab49?**

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Manager (B2B)
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**What you'll do:**

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours?
* You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

**What we're looking for:**

* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

**Experience**

* 5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

**Role Overview**

  

This role will own the product vision for simplifying and automating how schedule changes are identified, evaluated, communicated, and resolved, helping airlines reduce manual servicing while delivering a better traveller experience.

The Senior Product Manager will work across airline operations, reservations, servicing, reaccommodation, notifications, digital channels, and partner ecosystems to build scalable capabilities that support airlines with different business models, workflows, and levels of automation.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

**Product Strategy & Ownership**

  

Define how the product evolves from manual and rules-based servicing towards increasingly **automated, intelligent, and self-service schedule change management** .

* Translate airline operational challenges and traveller needs into clear product requirements, features, and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritise investments based on customer value, operational impact, strategic alignment, and technical feasibility.

**Schedule Change & Airline Servicing Expertise**

* Develop solutions covering the end-to-end schedule change lifecycle, including: Detection and classification of itinerary changes.Assessment of impacted passengers and itineraries.Airline policies and reaccommodation rules.Identification and presentation of alternative flights.Automated and agent-assisted reaccommodation.Traveller notification and acceptance.Digital self-service.Ticketing and servicing considerations.Handling of ancillary products and associated services.Interline and partner-airline scenarios.Exceptions requiring manual intervention.
* Ensure solutions can support different airline policies, thresholds, workflows, and customer servicing strategies.
* Partner with adjacent product areas such as **DCS, reservations, disruption management/IROPs, retailing, customer servicing, notifications, and airport solutions** .

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Engage directly with airline customers to understand current workflows, pain points, requirements, and desired business outcomes.
* Serve as a product subject-matter expert in customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and roadmap reviews.
* Monitor airline industry trends and evolving expectations around automated servicing and traveller self-service.
* Balance individual airline requirements with the development of scalable product capabilities.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, operations, and other product teams to translate strategy into executable product increments.
* Develop clear epics, requirements, acceptance criteria, and business priorities.
* Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
* Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
* Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

**Commercial & Business Outcomes**

* Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
* Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
* Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, preferably within **airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations** .
* Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
* Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
* Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
* Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
* Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
* Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
* Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including **Offers and Orders** , would be beneficial.
* Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
* Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
* Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

### **What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.

They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.

Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.

### **Ideal Candidate**

This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They are comfortable moving from a detailed conversation about servicing rules or reaccommodation logic to an executive discussion about automation, customer experience, revenue protection, and operating cost.

They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for the Single Ingest Platform across linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and every other source type our datasets depend on.
* Own the speed and accuracy of getting partner data into Gracenote, from onboarding new sources to processing every update.

title: Digital Product Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Syngenta is one of the world’s leading agriculture innovation company (Part of Syngenta Group) dedicated to improving global food security by enabling millions of farmers to make better use of available resources. Through world class science and innovative crop solutions, our **60,000** people in over **100** countries are working to transform how crops are grown. We are committed to rescuing land from degradation, enhancing biodiversity and revitalizing rural communities.

A diverse workforce and an inclusive workplace environment are enablers of our ambition to be the most collaborative and trusted team in agriculture. Our employees reflect the diversity of our customers, the markets where we operate and the communities which we serve. No matter what your position, you will have a vital role in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet.

To learn more visit: www.syngenta.com

 **Job Description**

Role Purpose:

The Digital Product Manager AMEA is responsible and accountable for assigned digital products that support growers across Crop Protection and Seeds in AMEA.

The successful candidate will translate regional strategy and country business needs into a clear grower product vision, prioritized roadmap, and measurable delivery plan. Reporting to the AMEA Digital Strategy and Product management Lead, this person will connect commercial stakeholders, country teams, product squads, and global platform owners to implement solutions, drive adoption, and realize business value across AMEA markets.

Accountabilities:

1. Product Strategy and Lifecycle Ownership

* Own the vision, objectives, and end-to-end roadmap for assigned digital products, aligning grower and commercial needs with AMEA priorities and relevant global product strategies.
* Translate business opportunities into prioritized product requirements, user journeys, release plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product discovery through user research, process analysis, competitive review, and market assessment, with regular validation from growers, customers, and commercial teams.
* Manage the product lifecycle from ideation and business case through build, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
* Balance regional consistency with country-specific requirements, reusing scalable capabilities while addressing material market differences.

2. Commercial Partnership and Business Transformation

* Partner with Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Commercial Operations, Crop Protection, and Seeds leaders to shape product priorities and support regional business transformation.
* Convert commercial processes and pain points into practical digital solutions that improve customer experience, execution quality, speed, and decision-making.
* Support country and regional product launches by coordinating process change, readiness, communication, training, and adoption activities.
* Act as the day-to-day product partner for business stakeholders, connecting long-term strategy with timely and pragmatic delivery decisions.

3. Business Case, Value Realisation and Adoption

* Develop and maintain business cases for new capabilities and major enhancements, defining expected value, investment needs, assumptions, risks, and success measures.
* Prioritize investments based on strategic fit, customer value, commercial impact, delivery feasibility, total cost, and reuse potential across markets.
* Own value-realisation plans and track product adoption, benefits, ROI, and operating performance with Finance, Commercial, and Analytics partners.
* Use performance data and customer feedback to identify adoption barriers, recommend corrective actions, and inform future roadmap decisions.

4. Stakeholder, Team and Delivery Leadership

* Build effective relationships with Country Digital Leads, Commercial Directors, functional leaders, global product owners, IT teams, vendors, and delivery partners.
* Lead or coordinate 2–3 Business Analysts or product team members as assigned, setting clear objectives, responsibilities, development priorities, and quality expectations.
* Facilitate alignment across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Agronomy, Data, IT, Legal, Privacy, and Security to resolve dependencies and unblock delivery.
* Guide agile or squad-based delivery by maintaining a clear backlog, making timely trade-offs, and ensuring acceptance criteria reflect business and user needs.
* Communicate product strategy, roadmap, risks, decisions, and results to regional and country stakeholders using concise evidence-based narratives.

5. Governance, Platforms and Performance

* Define and monitor product KPIs covering customer experience, adoption, process performance, commercial value, reliability, and cost.
* Apply product governance, investment, architecture, data privacy, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements throughout the lifecycle.
* Coordinate implementation and integration with relevant commercial platforms, which may include Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA, DTP, Lynx, Cropwise, analytics, and content or commerce platforms.
* Maintain product health and delivery reporting, escalating material risks early and driving continuous improvement based on evidence.

Knowledge, Experience & Capabilities

Required Experience

* 12+ years of relevant experience in digital product management, commercial transformation, business analysis, or technology-enabled business change, with direct responsibility for product outcomes.
* Commercial domain experience in Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Commercial Operations, CRM, e-commerce, or related customer-facing processes.
* Experience delivering and scaling digital products across multiple markets in a matrixed, multinational organization.
* Demonstrated ability to create business cases, prioritize investments, track benefits, and communicate ROI and product performance to senior stakeholders.
* Practical experience with agile, product-led, or squad-based delivery and the management of roadmaps, backlogs, releases, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating small teams, Business Analysts, vendors, or delivery partners.
* Agriculture, Crop Protection, Seeds, FMCG, or another complex commercial sector experience is preferred; cross-cultural experience across AMEA is an advantage.

Knowledge

* Digital product lifecycle practices, including strategy, discovery, user-centred design, delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, iteration, and retirement.
* Commercial value chains and processes across marketing, pricing, sales, customer engagement, product launches, and commercial planning.
* Digital and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA, DTP, Lynx, Cropwise, CRM, e-commerce, content, data, and analytics solutions.
* Business value measurement, including investment appraisal, benefits tracking, ROI, adoption metrics, and product performance reporting.
* Data privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory, and responsible AI considerations affecting digital product deployment across multiple markets.

Capabilities

* Strategic and commercial thinking: Connects customer and business needs to product choices, while understanding value drivers, trade-offs, and market dynamics.
* Product judgement: Makes practical, timely decisions using evidence; balances user value, business impact, technical feasibility, cost, risk, and speed.
* Influence without authority: Builds alignment across regional, country, global, and cross-functional stakeholders through clear logic, data, and constructive challenge.
* Customer and grower empathy: Uses direct insight to understand needs, behaviours, and adoption barriers, and converts that understanding into product decisions.
* Delivery and people leadership: Creates clarity, holds teams accountable for outcomes, coaches others, and maintains momentum through ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Cross-cultural collaboration: Builds trust across diverse AMEA markets and adapts communication and delivery approaches without losing strategic consistency.

Critical Success Factors & Key Challenges

Critical Success Factors (24-month horizon)

* Assigned product roadmaps are aligned to AMEA and country commercial priorities, with transparent decisions, approved business cases, and clear ownership.
* Priority product launches or major enhancements are delivered with validated user and business value, appropriate quality, and effective market readiness.
* Adoption and value-realisation targets are agreed, measured, and actively managed, with evidence of improved customer experience or commercial process performance.
* Product governance and reporting provide stakeholders with reliable visibility of investment, delivery status, risks, adoption, benefits, and product health.
* Country teams, global platform owners, and product squads work to shared priorities with dependencies and decisions resolved in a timely manner.
* Business Analysts and product team members show measurable growth in product thinking, stakeholder engagement, analysis quality, and delivery discipline.

Key Challenges

* Balancing regional standardization and platform reuse with diverse country processes, customer needs, regulations, and levels of digital maturity.
* Prioritizing limited investment and delivery capacity across competing country, regional, functional, and global demands.
* Driving adoption and sustained behaviour change when the product depends on new commercial processes, data quality, local capability, or customer trust.
* Integrating global and regional platforms while managing legacy systems, technical dependencies, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory constraints.
* Maintaining delivery momentum and measurable value while requirements, market conditions, and stakeholder priorities evolve.

 **Qualifications**

Education B.tech/MBA,

12+ years of relevant experience in digital product management, commercial transformation, business analysis, or technology-enabled business change, with direct responsibility for product outcomes.

 **Additional Information**

Innovations

The employee may, as part of the role and through multifunctional teams, participate in the creation and design of innovative solutions, contributing to inventions, designs, product work, know-how, copyrights, software, and other intellectual assets.

title: Senior Product Manager - Fully Remote Job
description:
#### **About the company**

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.  
  
We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.  
  
A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.  
  
At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.  
  
Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?  
  
Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.  
  
**Our values**

* **Be a wolf, not a sheep:** we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
* **Knowledge equals power:** we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
* **Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy:** we want work to be something you look forward to.
* **Quality results in quantity:** we care about excellence and attention to detail.
* **TEAM, Together everyone achieves more:** collaboration is how we get our best results.

Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

#### **About the role**

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.
* Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.
* Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.
* Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.
* Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.
* Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

#### **What we are looking for**

**Competences**

* **Hosting & Security Products Knowledge:** Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.
* **Supplier & Vendor Management:** Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.
* **Commercial & P&L Acumen:** Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.
* **Product Strategy & Roadmapping:** Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.
* **Project & Programme Management:** Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
* **Data & Funnel Analytics:** Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
* **AI Proficiency:** Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

**How we work at Openprovider**

* **Self-management:** you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
* **Learning Agility and AI Literacy:** you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
* **Adaptive Innovation Mindset:** you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
* **Quality Orientation:** you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
* **Customer Focus:** you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

#### **What we offer**

* 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
* Paid time off and sick leave;
* International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
* Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
* Quarterly review and annual salary review;
* Flexible working hours;
* We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
* Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

#### **About us**

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.

Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.

This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.
* Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.
* Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.
* Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.
* Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.

* A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.
* Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.

* Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.

description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Job Description
  
Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI (DA&AI)
  
At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. When applying internally, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor before applying.
  
  
Path/Level

Technical Product Manager, Lilly USA Tech@Lilly – DA&AI

Information Technology
  
Location

Reports to
  
Director, CTI Commercial India, Tech@Lilly
  
  
**Note:** Roles are posted at the lowest level of a band. Employees hired into banded positions transfer at their current level, despite the level indicated in the posting.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Technical Product Manager (TPM) owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization and value realization for Lilly USA Commercial Sales data and analytics products. The role translates the needs of Sales Operations, field leadership and commercial teams into trusted, reusable data products and analytical capabilities that improve field effectiveness, customer engagement and business decision-making.
  
This individual-contributor role combines strong Commercial Sales stakeholder partnership with formal product management accountability. It moves beyond demand intake and status coordination to owning product outcomes, roadmap decisions, prioritization, adoption and measurable business value.
  
The TPM owns the Sales vertical product direction and business outcomes while partnering with platform Product Owners, Data Architects, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, engineering, quality and compliance teams that retain accountability for their respective platform, architecture and delivery responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product vision, strategy and roadmap
  
  

* Define and communicate a multi-quarter data-product vision and roadmap for Commercial Sales, aligned with Commercial Unit priorities and the broader Data & AI strategy.
* Translate business problems such as field effectiveness, targeting and customer engagement into validated product opportunities, data requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritize the roadmap and backlog using business value, urgency, strategic alignment, effort, risk, compliance, capacity and dependency trade-offs; make and defend scope decisions with leadership.
* Maintain a transparent roadmap, release outlook and product lifecycle plan, clearly communicating changes in priorities, capacity, funding or dependencies.
* Align the Sales roadmap with reusable enterprise capabilities, platform roadmaps and relevant AI innovation initiatives before approving vertical-specific development.

Product discovery and data-product definition
  
  

* Lead structured discovery with field users, Sales Operations, reporting teams to understand decisions, workflows, unmet needs and pain points before defining solutions.
* Validate problems and proposed product concepts through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, data analysis, usability testing and field feedback.
* Define the business contract for each Sales data product, including intended consumers, decision use cases, product grain, key identifiers, business definitions, source systems, refresh expectations, quality thresholds, access requirements and service expectations, in partnership with the Business Analyst and Data Architect.
* Maintain a clear product catalogue covering product purpose, business owner, product owner, consumers, lifecycle status, dependencies, service expectations and adoption measures.

End-to-end product delivery and acceptance
  
  

* Own product outcomes from validated opportunity through production adoption, including scope, prioritization, release decisions, enablement and post-launch value tracking.
* Own product priorities, backlog ordering and timely scope decisions; partner with the Business Analyst to translate outcomes into epics, features, user stories, data requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the Scrum Master so planning refinement, reviews and delivery ceremonies support product priorities and timely decisions.
* Work with data engineers, analysts, ML engineers, quality teams and architects to resolve product questions and make informed value, usability, risk and sequencing trade-offs.
* Establish business acceptance criteria, coordinate UAT with authorized Sales stakeholders and secure business sign-off before release.
* Ensure critical Sales measures are reconciled across source systems, data products and consuming reports before production adoption.
* Coordinate product acceptance and operational handover to downstream analytics and reporting teams, including documentation, access, support ownership and known limitations.
* Track delivery and product health, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, quality concerns, cost considerations and mitigation decisions.

Stakeholder, portfolio and operating-model leadership
  
  

* Act as the single point of accountability and voice of the product for Commercial business partners, Sales Operations, field leadership and technology stakeholders.
* Lead regular Sales product reviews covering roadmap, value realized, adoption, product health, dependencies, risks and decisions required.
* Lead quarterly demand, capacity and sequencing discussions for the Sales data-product portfolio, balancing business value, urgency, strategic alignment, risk, technical dependencies and available delivery capacity.
* Assess existing enterprise data products, approved patterns and reusable platform capabilities before starting new development.
* Contribute to maintaining the Sales DA&AI operating model, decision rights and RACI, recommending updates when product, platform or delivery accountabilities change.
* Provide concise executive updates and evidence-based investment recommendations, including the consequences of funding, capacity and sequencing decisions.

Data, AI and regulated-environment stewardship
  
  

* Champion and apply architecture, data-governance, privacy, security, quality and compliance standards established by the accountable enterprise teams.
* Promote trusted business definitions, data quality, lineage, appropriate access and a consistent source of truth for Sales and Commercial measures.
* Identify and validate Sales problems that may benefit from analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities.
* Partner with Business Analysts and engineering teams to assess feasibility, data readiness, responsible-AI considerations and measurable business value.
* Support the transition of successful proofs of concept into governed, supportable and adoptable Sales products.

Value realization, adoption and lifecycle management
  
  

* Define success measures before investment and track outcomes after release, using appropriate business, product, data-quality, adoption and delivery measures.
* Drive change management, training, communications and field enablement so intended users adopt and benefit from the products.
* Continuously improve products through evidence-based releases, address low adoption or quality concerns and retire low-value or duplicative capabilities.

Role Accountability and Decision Rights
  
  
The TPM is accountable for why the product is needed, whom it serves, what outcomes it must deliver, what is prioritized and whether value is realized. The TPM partners with the Business Analyst on detailed requirements, the Scrum Master on delivery ceremonies, the Data Architect on architecture and governance standards, engineering and quality teams on implementation and validation, and platform Product Owners on reusable capabilities and technical roadmaps.
  
  
Qualifications and Skills
  
  
Required
  
  

* Relevant experience in technology, data, analytics or digital product delivery, including substantial experience owning data, analytics or AI products in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven record of owning product discovery, vision, roadmap, prioritization, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management in an Agile environment such as Scrum or SAFe.
* Experience working with Commercial Sales, Sales Operations, CRM, field-force or customer-engagement data and platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva or similar.
* Strong data literacy, including the ability to interpret data models, SQL outputs, dashboards, business measures, quality indicators and analytical results.
* Working knowledge of modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Databricks and AWS, including Lakehouse concepts, data pipelines, data modelling, semantic layers, business intelligence and ML/AI product lifecycles. The role is not expected to be a hands-on data engineer but must engage credibly with technical teams and make informed product trade-offs.
* Experience with product discovery, outcome-based roadmaps, business acceptance, UAT, product adoption and measurable product KPIs.
* Experience managing priorities, dependencies, capacity and sequencing across multiple business and delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of Jira or Azure DevOps for product backlog and roadmap management.
* Demonstrated understanding of data governance, privacy, security, quality, compliance and responsible AI in a regulated environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, negotiation and consulting skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and global cross-time-zone teams without formal authority.

Preferred

description:
Senior Product Manager — KYC Platform
  
  
Build the onboarding backbone that powers every credit product PayU Finance owns.
  
  
ABOUT PAYU FINANCE INDIA
  
  
PayU Finance India Limited is one of India's fastest-growing digital lending businesses, operating at the intersection of payments, credit, and technology. Through our flagship consumer product LazyPay and a rapidly expanding suite of merchant lending solutions, we serve millions of Indians with instant, responsible credit — making financial access simple, fair, and digital-first.
  
  
We are building the credit infrastructure for the next 500 million Indians. As a regulated NBFC backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest technology investors, we combine the agility of a startup with the governance of a regulated financial institution. Our teams solve hard problems in underwriting, platform engineering, compliance, and product — at scale, in real time.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
As the Senior Product Manager for KYC Platform at PayU Finance, you will own the end-to-end Know Your Customer (KYC) infrastructure that underpins every lending product we operate — LazyPay consumer credit, merchant lending, BNPL, co-lending, and future lines of business. This is a platform role, not a product feature role. You will think in systems: designing scalable, partner-agnostic KYC journeys that can be configured, extended, and reused across business units. You will work closely with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Data, and external partners including KYC bureaus, video-KYC vendors, DigiLocker, UIDAI, and banking correspondents. You will set the gold standard for compliant, frictionless onboarding at PayU Finance.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  
**Define and own the KYC Platform roadmap:** design a modular, API-first KYC platform that serves all internal business units as internal consumers — eliminating duplication and enabling faster product launches.
  
**Drive platform thinking:** abstract KYC flows into reusable components (identity verification, liveness, document parsing, de-dup, risk flagging) and define clear platform contracts for product teams to build on.
  
**Lead partner integration strategy:** evaluate, onboard, and manage integrations with KYC vendors (CKYC, video-KYC, DigiLocker, UIDAI, PAN validation, face-match), negotiate SLAs, and own fallback logic.
  
**Translate regulatory requirements into product specs:** work alongside Compliance and Legal to convert RBI, PMLA, and FATF guidelines into product requirements — including re-KYC cycles, audit trail design, and data retention policies.
  
**Build with data:** define KYC funnel metrics, drop-off analytics, and fraud signals. Use data to reduce onboarding friction while maintaining regulatory thresholds. Continuously A/B test and iterate on the onboarding journey.
  
**Enable developer experience:** define clear API specifications, documentation, and sandbox environments so product and engineering teams across PayU Finance can self-serve on KYC without ad-hoc requests.
  
**Plan for scale and longevity:** architect KYC flows that can handle 10x volume, support new product lines (UPI credit, co-lending, embedded finance), and adapt to evolving RBI regulations without re-engineering from scratch.
  
**Drive governance:** own the KYC health dashboard — approval rates, STP rates, failure categorisation, re-KYC compliance, audit readiness — and present to senior leadership and regulators.
  
  
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  
**Platform product experience:** 6–9 years in product management with at least 2–3 years owning a platform or infrastructure product — ideally in fintech, payments, or financial services.
  
**Regulated entity experience:** hands-on experience working within an RBI-regulated NBFC, bank, or payment aggregator — you understand what compliance means when there is a penalty for getting it wrong.
  
**Technical depth:** you can read API documentation, review a system design, and hold your own in an engineering discussion. You understand OAuth flows, webhook architectures, and data pipelines.
  
**Data-driven mindset:** you define success with metrics before you build. You are comfortable running SQL queries, interpreting funnel analytics, and building the business case from data.
  
**Partner management:** you have experience evaluating and onboarding third-party vendors, writing integration requirement documents, and managing SLA accountability.
  
**Long-term systems thinking:** you do not build for the next quarter — you design for the next three years. You document architectural decisions and think about backward compatibility, versioning, and deprecation.
  
**Communication:** you can write a one-pager that makes a compliance officer and an engineer agree on priorities. You communicate clearly, escalate appropriately, and drive alignment without authority.
  
  
GOOD TO HAVE
  
  
Experience in KYC/AML domain — CKYC, V-CIP, DigiLocker, UIDAI API integrations
  
**Knowledge of lending workflows:** loan origination, credit bureau pulls, underwriting triggers
  
Exposure to co-lending or white-label lending platforms
  
Familiarity with PMLA, RBI Master Directions on KYC (2016, as updated), and FATF guidelines
  
Experience with identity fraud detection, liveness check providers, or device intelligence
  
  
WHY PAYU FINANCE?
  
  
Own a platform product that will directly power India's next wave of digital credit — from consumer to merchant to embedded finance
  
Work at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering in one of India's most complex regulatory environments
  
Build from the ground up — this role has significant greenfield opportunity to set the architecture, not just maintain it
  
Be part of a Prosus-backed, profitable business with the scale of a large company and the decision-making speed of a startup

title: Senior Principal - Product Owner - EUC/MDM
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
Own the product for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries get, use and are supported on their devices — with particular depth on the mobile estate: iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and the field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices that behave nothing like them.

This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped.

The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and articulate the product vision for end user services and mobile device management — a clear statement of what the service will be in 18 months and why that matters to the business.
* Maintain a rolling roadmap that balances new capability, technical debt, security and compliance obligations, and experience improvement; keep it honest about capacity.
* Translate the EUC strategy and architecture direction into a sequenced, deliverable product backlog.
* Own the business case and benefits realisation for product investment; be accountable for the value claimed, not just the spend approved.
* Own, refine and prioritise the product backlog as the single source of truth for the squad; make prioritisation calls transparently and defend them.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from and testers can verify — specific about the outcome, not prescriptive about the solution.
* Lead sprint planning, refinement, review and retrospective alongside the Scrum Master; accept or reject work against acceptance criteria.
* Manage dependencies across adjacent squads — identity, security, networking, service management — and escalate early when they threaten delivery.
* Own the release and change approach for user-visible change, including pilot rings, communications and rollback triggers.
* Be the voice of the employee in every prioritisation conversation, and hold the evidence to back it: research, telemetry, ticket analysis and direct observation.
* Run continuous discovery — user interviews, shadowing in the field and on the shop floor, surveys, usability testing — with the populations who are least like head office.
* Convert digital experience (DEX) telemetry and service desk data into prioritised, root-cause-addressing backlog items; treat every recurring ticket category as a product defect until proven otherwise.
* Own adoption: define what good adoption looks like before launch, measure it after, and act when it does not materialise.
* Own the product for the mobile estate: enrolment and provisioning experience, BYOD vs. corporate-owned models, app catalogue and distribution, and the employee-facing side of mobile security policy.
* Own the BYOD proposition end to end — the privacy commitment, the employee terms, the enrolment journey and the trust that makes people willing to participate.
* Manage the mobile OS release cycle as a recurring product event: annual iOS and Android major releases, beta assessment, compatibility validation and controlled rollout.
* Own the product relationship with mobile carriers, MDM platform vendors and app suppliers.
* Build and maintain relationships across business units, regions and functions; run a stakeholder forum or product council that makes trade-offs visible rather than fought in private.
* Partner with Cyber Security to land control changes in ways employees will accept and comply with — security outcomes delivered through good product design rather than mandate.
* Engage works councils, employee representatives and Privacy where mobile telemetry, BYOD or device monitoring is in scope.
* Report on product performance to senior stakeholders in outcome terms.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
* Product ownership certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe POPM, Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), ITIL v4 Foundation, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership at scale for end user services and mobile device management, with direct working familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform (e.g., Microsoft Intune).
* Mobile estate strategy across iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and specialised field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices.
* Digital employee experience (DEX) and service-desk-driven product improvement, using telemetry and ticket analysis to prioritise root-cause fixes.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and 12+ years in technology delivery, including 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager with genuine backlog authority (not a business analyst writing another team's requirements).
* Product or service ownership serving 10,000+ users across multiple countries.
* Demonstrable hands-on product experience in end user computing, digital workplace or mobile device management — including direct familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform.
* Sustained experience owning a backlog for a cross-functional agile squad, through multiple release cycles, in a scaled delivery environment.
* Track record of using user research and quantitative telemetry to drive prioritisation, with a specific example of a decision the data changed.
* A demonstrable product outcome delivered and measured — adoption, experience, effort or cost — not merely a feature shipped.
* Proven ability to manage senior and conflicting stakeholders across business units and regions, and to hold a prioritisation decision under pressure.
* Fluent English; credible with both engineers and executives in a global matrixed organisation.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [10–15]% of the time — including to sites, labs and field locations where the devices are actually used.
* Desirable:
* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP-validated systems and the change control that comes with them.
* Product ownership for specialised or frontline mobile devices: rugged handhelds, lab and clinical devices, field-force tablets, shared/kiosk devices, scanners and shop-floor endpoints.
* Experience with deskless and frontline worker populations — employees without a corporate laptop, whose primary device is shared or personal.
* Works council and employee-representation engagement, particularly on BYOD, mobile telemetry and device monitoring.
* Mobile app product experience — internal app store curation, in-house mobile app lifecycle, MAM policy design.
* Experience delivering a major platform migration or transition as a product owner — MDM platform change, MSP transition, or BYOD programme launch.
* Service design or UX research background; journey mapping and service blueprinting.
* Carrier and telecom management — mobile contracts, eSIM, international roaming, expense management.
* AI-enabled workplace tooling product experience — Copilot, virtual agents, AI-assisted support deflection.
* Accessibility and assistive technology as a designed-in part of the device proposition.
* Sustainability — device longevity, refurbishment and circular IT built into the product roadmap.

**Skills/Background**

* Deep product craft across backlog ownership, outcome-based requirements, continuous discovery, and value definition and measurement.
* Endpoint management platform fluency (Microsoft Intune or comparable MDM/UEM tooling) — enough to have credible conversations with engineers and challenge estimates.
* Understanding of endpoint security fundamentals — conditional access, compliance policy, encryption — and the trade-offs each imposes on the user.
* Fluency in agile delivery tooling (Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow) — able to run a backlog others can actually read.
* Influence without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery, regions and vendors through evidence and relationship.
* Communication — equally credible in a sprint refinement and in a steering committee; able to translate technical constraint into business consequence.
* Comfort with conflict — the role exists at the intersection of security, cost and experience, and someone is always disappointed.
* Bias to evidence — willing to change position when the data contradicts a strongly held view, including their own.

**Skills**

Agile Leadership, Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, GxPs, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Platform Development, Process Diagrams, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
